Detector x → · y ↑ · not north up

Select a pixel for original IMAGE, FLAGS, VARIANCE, wavelength and ICRS position.

Nearest-neighbor display only. Purple / neutral pixels are excluded measurements in both mask modes. Color and contrast are display choices; they do not add detail or change flux.

Native data diagnostics

Background is the median of valid pixels, including sources and diffuse emission. It is not a fitted sky level. Image variance describes spatial spread; the VARIANCE extension describes native measurement uncertainty.

Source & mask evidence

Missing coverage outside the cutout is distinct from a flagged or nonfinite sample inside it. Bright or dark usable pixels cannot be identified as detector defects from appearance alone.

Sources, methods & SKYSHIFT

        
      

      
      Replay intro →
      
SKYSHIFT is an independent Project Mercury Team application. It displays dated SPHEREx DR1 and QR3 cutouts with their detector, wavelength and archive source.

      
Wavelength, processing and masked pixels can change how the same field looks. Treat visual differences as questions to investigate.
